name: Soucouyant
description: The soucouyant is a figure of Caribbean folklore: an old woman by day who at night sheds her skin, transforms into a ball of fire, and flies in search of victims whose blood she drains. She is defeated by finding her shed skin and salting it so she cannot return to human form before sunrise.

aliases.name: Ole Higue / Ol' Higue / Ole Haig

origin: Across the Caribbean, including Anglophone, Francophone, and Dutch-speaking territories, with diaspora reach into the United States (notably Louisiana) and Canada.
